body.name: Conditional projected-covariance root-set estimator
body.construction: Conditional on the source-prime chart hypothesis and successful finite output of \(\mathrm{thm:conditional\mbox{-}geometric\mbox{-}resolution}\), if \(S_m\) lies in the tubular neighborhood of \(\mathcal K_G\), \(\pi_G(S_m)\notin\mathcal E_{G,e}\), and the supplied circuits evaluate validly, set \(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{e,m}=\{z\in\mathbb R:p_e(\pi_G(S_m),z)=0\text{ and }\mathsf{LiftCert}(z,\pi_G(S_m))\text{ accepts}\}\), retaining every accepted branch and selecting none; otherwise set \(\widehat{\mathcal R}_{e,m}=\varnothing\).
